summary: Three Lions Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading on Nasdaq (TLACU/TLAC/TLACW), filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying ordinary shares and warrants commencing on or about September 17, 2026. Separated shares and warrants will trade under TLAC and TLACW; unseparated units remain TLACU. No price, stake, premium, or deal terms were stated. The early separation follows the typical post-IPO mechanic, with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust as transfer agent. No business combination or target was disclosed. Watch for deal announcement timing and any redemption/trust dynamics ahead of the combination deadline.
